_doc: Whether SES receiving is really on (docs/email/01-ses.md). The SES REGION is not declared here: it is SES_REGION in the estate identity (estate/identity.yaml), its one source. email-sync.mjs carries both into senders.generated.json, which the lifecycle scripts read, and refuses what disagrees with the identity: a region written into iam-policy.json (it says ${SES_REGION}, filled by ses-account-bootstrap.sh) or into the sentinel default in externalsecrets.yaml (it says WLSESREGION, filled by the piece's replacements), DNS data in ses-domains.json generated for another region, and receiving regions in the OpenTofu variables.tf that differ from SES_REGION's allow-list in schema/identity.schema.json (a region where SES cannot receive is refused by the identity loader). The value Plunk runs with is secret/platform/ses/admin `region`: ses-tofu.sh and doctor.sh refuse or fail when that one differs. Moving regions: change SES_REGION in the identity, regenerate the whitelabel ConfigMap, run email-sync, follow what it refuses; an identity and its DKIM do not move with it. `receiving` is false until environments/ses-events has been applied with the wider key (docs/email/01-ses.md). While false, no inbound MX is published and doctor says so at every run.
